title_working: In This World, The First Word You Say Becomes Your Superpower

lines.text: In this world, the first word you ever say becomes your superpower.
lines.say: (confident) In this world, the first word you ever say becomes your superpower.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Jada said up, and now she floats. Leo said no, and nothing can touch him.
lines.say: (happy) Jada said up, and now she floats. Leo said no, and nothing can touch him.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex's first word was fast. He was the fastest kid in school, and he never let anyone forget it.
lines.say: (confident) Rex's first word was fast. He was the fastest kid in school, and he never let anyone forget it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then there was Marcus. His first word was mine.
lines.say: (nervous) Then there was Marcus. His first word was mine.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Anything he pointed at and said mine to became his. Only he could give it back.
lines.say: (nervous) Anything he pointed at and said mine to became his. Only he could give it back.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So everyone feared him. They called him the greediest kid alive.
lines.say: (sad) So everyone feared him. They called him the greediest kid alive.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: But Marcus never took anything. His shoes were falling apart, and his cough never stopped.
lines.say: (sad) But Marcus never took anything. His shoes were falling apart, and his cough never stopped.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One day, Rex asked, You can take anything. Why not take new shoes?
lines.say: (surprised) One day, Rex asked, You can take anything. Why not take new shoes?
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus said, I already took the only thing I wanted. Then he walked away, coughing.
lines.say: (soft tone) Marcus said, I already took the only thing I wanted. Then he walked away, coughing.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The next week, Rex's new running shoes vanished.
lines.say: (surprised) The next week, Rex's new running shoes vanished.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone turned to Marcus. Rex shouted, Give them back!
lines.say: (angry) Everyone turned to Marcus. Rex shouted, Give them back!
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus did not even look up. A week later, the shoes turned up in another kid's locker. Nobody said sorry.
lines.say: (sad) Marcus did not even look up. A week later, the shoes turned up in another kid's locker. Nobody said sorry.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That night, Rex followed Marcus home to apologize.
lines.say: (nervous) That night, Rex followed Marcus home to apologize.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Through the window, he saw a little girl laughing in bed. Marcus's sister.
lines.say: (happy) Through the window, he saw a little girl laughing in bed. Marcus's sister.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: On her wall hung an old get-well card, from last year.
lines.say: (soft tone) On her wall hung an old get-well card, from last year.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus had said mine to her sickness. Now he was the one who coughed.
lines.say: (surprised) Marcus had said mine to her sickness. Now he was the one who coughed.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex knocked. Marcus, pale and shaking, whispered, Go away.
lines.say: (sad) Rex knocked. Marcus, pale and shaking, whispered, Go away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex said, Give it to me.
lines.say: (confident) Rex said, Give it to me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus whispered, You can't outrun it.
lines.say: (sad) Marcus whispered, You can't outrun it.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex smiled. Watch me.
lines.say: (confident) Rex smiled. Watch me.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Marcus gave it back. The cough hit Rex, and he ran.
lines.say: (surprised) Marcus gave it back. The cough hit Rex, and he ran.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Faster than he had ever run. The sickness fell behind and faded away.
lines.say: (happy) Faster than he had ever run. The sickness fell behind and faded away.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The greediest kid alive had only taken one thing: his sister's pain.
lines.say: (soft tone) The greediest kid alive had only taken one thing: his sister's pain.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And the fastest kid in school finally had something worth running for.
lines.say: (happy) And the fastest kid in school finally had something worth running for.
lines.speaker: narrator
